pois.name: DEV Riverside Supply Chest
pois.entrance: DEV cave opening on the north riverbank
navigation_steps: Start at the DEV Timber Footbridge and follow the river west.
Use the cave opening at water level instead of descending from the ridge.
Follow the left tunnel to the lower chamber.
solution_steps: Clear the DEV training enemies in the chamber.
Use the DEV Fire Arrow on the marked vines.
Open the fixture chest behind the stone screen.
pois.common_mistake: The fixture cannot be reached from the cliff directly above it.

pois.name: DEV Watchtower Chest
pois.entrance: DEV broken stair on the east face
navigation_steps: Approach the DEV Signal Tower from the east path.
Climb the broken exterior stair and cross the timber beam.
solution_steps: Defeat the fixture guard at the upper platform.
Open the chest beside the signal brazier.
pois.common_mistake: The west wall is decorative and has no climb route.

pois.name: DEV Sunken Courtyard Chest
pois.entrance: DEV well behind the ruined courtyard
navigation_steps: Enter the DEV Reed Gate courtyard from the southern path.
Drop through the marked well and take the second ladder down.
solution_steps: Unlock the fixture grate with the DEV Courtyard Key.
Drain the shallow room with the nearby lever.
Open the chest on the lower stone shelf.
pois.common_mistake: The first underground room is B1. Continue down to B2.

pois.name: DEV Wind Bell Oddity
navigation_steps: Follow the terrace path north from the DEV Twin Willows.
Look for the bell hanging under the final wooden arch.
solution_steps: Interact with the three fixture chimes from lowest to highest.
Collect the revealed oddity beneath the center arch.
pois.common_mistake: Do not strike the large bell first. It resets the fixture sequence.

pois.name: DEV Moss Stone Oddity
pois.entrance: DEV ridge trail from the south
navigation_steps: Take the ridge trail north from the DEV Three Pines.
Stop at the moss-covered stones above the path.
solution_steps: Use the DEV Observation skill to reveal the correct stone.
Inspect the highlighted carving.
pois.common_mistake: The bright stone beside the path is a decoy fixture.

pois.name: DEV Lantern Alignment
navigation_steps: Cross the DEV Stone Crossing and enter the courtyard to the north.
The four lantern stands surround the central tile.
solution_steps: Rotate each fixture lantern toward the central tile.
Stand on the tile after all four beams meet.
pois.common_mistake: One lantern is on the roof edge, not at ground level.

pois.name: DEV Echo Chamber
pois.entrance: DEV narrow gap behind the waterfall
navigation_steps: Descend to the pool below the DEV Veil Falls.
Walk through the narrow gap behind the falling water.
solution_steps: Repeat the fixture tones in the order shown by the wall lights.
Use the opened passage to collect the completion token.
pois.common_mistake: The upper cave is not connected to the puzzle chamber.

pois.name: DEV Ferryman Request
navigation_steps: Follow the river path south to the DEV ferry landing.
Speak to the fixture ferryman beside the moored boat.
solution_steps: Give the ferryman the DEV River Token.
Complete the short fixture delivery across the river.
Return to the landing for the quest completion.
pois.common_mistake: The quest remains incomplete until you return to the original landing.

pois.name: DEV Herbalist Trail
navigation_steps: Take the meadow path east from the DEV Red Canopy.
Find the fixture herbalist beside the low stone wall.
solution_steps: Collect three marked DEV herbs along the meadow edge.
Return them to the fixture herbalist.
pois.common_mistake: The required herbs appear only after the prerequisite fixture quest.
